hypothesised_pattern: The base model misses a U-shaped (even) effect of x4, under-predicting when |x4| is roughly 1 or more and over-predicting when |x4| is small.
rationale: The five positive residuals have |x4| of 1.03, 1.66, 2.12, 0.96 and 1.10 with mixed signs, while the five negative residuals have |x4| of 0.52, 0.60, 0.48, 0.23 and 0.25. The split falls cleanly on the magnitude of x4 independent of its sign, pointing to a missing even term such as x4 squared.
